newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshi ship sinks near port, captain missing.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi ship sinks near port, captain missing.

text.p: A small Bangladeshi ship sank after colliding with another local vessel near Chittagong port late on Tuesday, port officials said on Wednesday.
The ship, bringing in cargo from a bulk carrier in the Bay of Bengal, went down with 1,200 tonnes of imported fertiliser.
The officials said 15 crew were rescued but the captain, whose identity was not immediately known, was missing.
